closure_rule: HUMAN_SOURCE_REVIEW_COMPLETE requires six explicit signed human verdicts; AI output must never populate human_reviewer.

items.localizer: IUT I, section I1, printed pp. 3-4
items.review_question: Confirm the source parameters and groups, and whether poly-actions retain arithmetic or geometric provenance through automorphism subquotients.
items.discriminant: Reject replacement by an ordinary action that has neither an automorphism subquotient nor source provenance.

items.review_question: Confirm poly-morphism as a collection or subset, poly-isomorphism, poly-automorphism, full variants and pairwise composition without multiplicity.
items.discriminant: A two-arrow collection is not equivalent to either selected singleton.

items.review_question: Confirm multiplicative labels, capsules, collections beta composed with phi composed with alpha, automorphism quotients and action by poly-automorphisms.
items.discriminant: This range may support the T03-T04 context but not the additive T05 model; label cardinality alone survives deletion of the categorical data.

items.review_question: Confirm the distinction among the signed finite-field group, its torsor, chart orbits and transformations z maps to plus or minus z plus lambda.
items.discriminant: Reject identification with an ordinary torsor under the entire affine group.

items.review_question: Confirm poly-automorphisms on indexed data, source and target poly-actions, and equivariance of the poly-morphism.
items.discriminant: An ordinary affine action continues to exist after the indexed categorical data are erased and therefore cannot by itself establish this source construction.

items.review_question: Confirm the bridge as a poly-morphism, indexed capsule, quotient by sign, constituent morphisms and compatibility conditions.
items.discriminant: Reject any claim that T01-T11 alone construct this geometric object.
